historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: year-1 base revenue growth. CAAC 2026 passenger-trip target +5.3%, H1 FY2026 revenue +5.6%, core ETD processing volumes +0.3%; set below the 5-year equity CAGR of 5.6% because the core distribution business is flat and growth is coming from lumpier airport digitalization and intelligent-products revenue.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (7.6% 3yr / 5.6% 5yr) diverges >30% from revenue (18.9% / 9.8%) and EPS (56% / 46%) CAGRs. The revenue and EPS figures are COVID-trough base effects (FY2020 revenue -32%, net profit -86%; FY2022 was still depressed), not a trend. The 7-year CAGRs from the pre-COVID FY2018 base -- revenue 2.3%, EPS 0.2% -- are the honest long-run picture: a mature business that has only just regained its FY2019 earnings level. Equity CAGR is the most informative series here.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs use the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less interest income; SBC is zero): FY2018 664, FY2019 1,147, FY2020 -487, FY2021 2,353, FY2022 882, FY2023 -549, FY2024 1,973, FY2025 1,965 (CNY m). The 5-year owner-FCF CAGR is undefined because FY2020 is negative. The series is dominated by clearing-float swings in other receivables/payables (FY2023 OCF 137m, FY2021 2,943m) and should not be read as an earnings trend; owner FCF averaged ~RMB1.2bn over FY2021-25 and ~RMB1.97bn over FY2024-25.

scenario_narratives.base: TravelSky remains the unchallenged system of record for Chinese civil aviation and grows roughly with passenger volumes less a modest take-rate drift: revenue +4.5% in FY2026 fading to 2.5%, owner EBITDA margin steady at 38-38.5%, capex normalising from the Shunyi Phase II peak to ~8% of revenue, and cash tax drifting from ~12% to 15%. The axes that matter are CAAC passenger-trip growth (target +5.3% for 2026), whether airport digitalization stays lumpy-but-positive, and whether the preferential tax regime is renewed; none of these moves value as much as the market's willingness to credit an SOE's RMB17.6bn of cash and financial assets, which the model takes at face.
scenario_narratives.bull: Volume recovery completes and new verticals (ACCA settlement, intelligent products, low-altitude economy, AI products) lift growth to 5-6% for several years; operating leverage takes margins to 40%; both tax preferences are renewed; the stock re-rates toward its pre-COVID 15-20x earnings range as dividends rise with the ~35-40% payout.
scenario_narratives.bear: The distribution core is ex-growth and its take-rate erodes under direct-sales mandates and OTA direct connects; state-directed pricing and investment priorities compress margins to 33%; tax preferences lapse; receivables from state airlines keep absorbing cash. The business remains profitable and cash-generative -- the bear case is a slowly shrinking regulated utility, not a solvency event.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF in CNY converted to the HKD quote. The operating business is valued on stripped operating cash flows (no interest, investment or fair-value income; leases expensed; working capital charged on growth) at a 9% CNY discount rate with a 15x terminal cap, and the RMB8.9bn of cash plus RMB9.2bn of deposits and financial assets are added at face per the matching-asset rule, less NCI and the dividend already declared. The result is far above the market price because the market applies a deep SOE/China governance discount to the cash pile; that discount is expressed here through a 30% bear weight and the discount rate, not by haircutting the assets, and the reader should treat the gap between IV and price as the price of trusting state-controlled capital allocation.
key_risks_to_valuation: Realisation risk on ~RMB17.6bn of net cash and financial assets held inside a state-controlled company with a ~35% payout and no buybacks; if that capital is never returned, roughly RMB6/share (HK$7/share) of the valuation is notional
State-directed pricing: distribution and settlement fees are negotiated with loss-making state airline shareholders and can be cut by CAAC fiat
Tax regime: HNTE 15% certification (2023-2025) and the 10% key-software refund are renewed periodically, not permanent; statutory rate is 25%
Air-travel shock: FY2020 showed revenue -32% and net profit -86% in a single year; not modelled explicitly in any scenario
Clearing float: ~RMB80-145bn/yr of pass-through BSP settlement flows make reported OCF noisy; a regulatory change to float handling could alter working capital materially
FX: RMB flows against an HKD quote; a 5% CNY depreciation moves every HKD value 5%
Governance continuity: board term expired Feb-2023 with re-election still in progress; new Chairman Dec-2025 and GM retirement Apr-2026

inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in the flows' currency (CNY): 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8%, China equity risk premium ~7% (incl. country/governance premium for an H-share SOE), beta ~1.0 for a regulated aviation-IT monopoly, giving a cost of equity ~8.8-9.0%. Borrowings (RMB996m) are ~2% of the capital structure against RMB8.9bn cash, so WACC equals cost of equity: 9.0%. Same WACC in all three scenarios -- cyclicality, SOE pricing intervention and governance risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not a second time in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost. The full lease cash payment (RMB124.2m FY2025, RMB129.9m FY2024, 'Cash paid for other financing activities'; ~RMB127m annualised from H1 FY2026) is charged inside the flows via lease_cost_pct_path at 1.4% of revenue. Lease liabilities (RMB241.9m at 30 June 2026: 106.0 non-current + ~136 within 'non-current liabilities maturing within one year') are therefore EXCLUDED from total_debt, which is borrowings only (short-term 512.8 + long-term 483.0 + 0.3 current portion = RMB995.7m per interim MD&A line 384). da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation: reported D&A FY2025 RMB899.3m (10.3% of revenue) less ~RMB125m ROU depreciation (ROU assets fell 286.9 -> 222.6 over H1 FY2026 with no material additions) = ~8.8%. The Metrics CSV total_debt of 1,239.1 includes leases and is deliberately not used here.
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated flows; NCI stock of RMB659.1m (30 June 2026) deducted once in the equity bridge. NCI profit share is small (RMB64.3m FY2025, 2.7% of net profit; RMB17.7m H1 FY2026). Calibration: FY0 owner EBIT 2,340 x (1-0.12) = ~2,059 NOPAT vs reported attributable net profit 2,341.6 less ~RMB335m after-tax non-operating income stripped (interest 115.9 + investment income 83.7 + FV gains 127.2 + impairment reversals 46.3 pre-tax) = ~2,006; ties within NCI/noise.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US adaptations (dual currency, leases, NCI, matching-asset rule, SBC-zero). TravelSky is an operating company -- a transaction-fee aviation IT/distribution/settlement monopoly -- so the owner-FCF engine applies; it is not a bank, REIT or holdco despite the large cash and investment pile. OWNER EBIT FY2025 (basis for the EBITDA margin path): operating profit 2,706.4 - interest income 115.9 + interest expense 20.6 - investment income 83.7 - fair-value gains 127.2 - credit impairment reversal 35.3 - asset impairment reversal 11.0 - other income (grants) 13.8 = 2,340.1; plus D&A 899.3 = EBITDA 3,239.4 = 37.0% of revenue (FY2024 on the same basis 38.8%). Every stripped income stream has its source asset in equity_bridge (matching-asset rule): structured deposits, CDs, reverse repos, the China Mobile Equity Fund LP, the CMRH Life stake and the associates. OWNER FCF FY2025: reported FCF 2,080.7 (OCF 2,923.5 - capex 842.8) - SBC 0 - interest income 115.9 = 1,964.8 (22.4% of revenue); investment returns are received in investing cash flow, so they are not inside reported OCF and need no further deduction. OCF is noisy year to year because the ACCA/BSP clearing float (RMB80-145bn/yr of pass-through receipts and payments) swings other receivables/payables; FY2023 OCF was only 137m and FY2021 2,943m for that reason. WORKING CAPITAL is negative on growth: receivables + notes of RMB4.96bn against revenue of 8.8bn (DSO ~200 days on state-airline customers), net working capital ex-cash and ex-dividend ~RMB1.3bn or ~15% of revenue, so wc_capture_pct is -15 (base). CAPEX: FY2025 842.8 (9.6%) vs 353.5 (4.0%) FY2024 and 527.9 (7.6%) FY2023; RMB1,774.9m of capex commitments outstanding at Dec-2025 (Beijing Shunyi Park Phase II) justify ~10% for FY2026-27 before fading to 8%, roughly equal to D&A at maturity. TAX: FY2025 effective rate 10.4% (15% High-and-New-Technology rate less the key-software 10% refund of 90.2m and R&D super-deduction 38.9m); HNTE certification covered 2023-2025 and renewal is routine but not guaranteed, so the base ramps 12% -> 15%, bear to 20%, bull holds 12%. CASH PILE: besides RMB8,860m cash and bank balances the group holds RMB6,019.5m structured bank deposits (note 5.2, principal-protected, 90-186 day), RMB525.6m 3-year CDs maturing within a year (5.9), RMB1,000.5m 7-day reverse repos of government bonds and RMB50.5m 1-year CDs (5.10), RMB124.6m CDs over one year (5.22); the FY2025 final dividend of RMB827.8m was payable at 30 June 2026 and paid after period end (the current price is ex-dividend), so it is deducted. Total bridge + net cash ~RMB17.6bn, about RMB6.0/share (HK$7.0/share), i.e. ~78% of the market price is backed by cash and financial assets; the market is pricing the operating business at roughly 2.5x owner FCF. That is the SOE/China governance discount: ~35% payout, no buybacks, state-directed capital allocation. The model values the assets at face as the method requires and prices that risk through a 30% bear weight and the 9% CNY discount rate; the realisation path for minorities is dividends only. Hong Kong market is SBC-zero: sbc_pct_path kept explicit at 0 so house = street and band_position collapses (should be null, not 0). FY2020 (revenue -32%, net profit -86%, credit impairment) is a COVID trough and is not used as an anchor anywhere.

bear.narrative: Core ETD volumes stay flat (H1 FY2026 +0.3%) while CAAC direct-sales mandates and OTA direct connects erode the distribution take-rate; state-directed pricing concessions to the loss-making state airlines and mandated tech-sovereignty spending compress owner EBITDA margin to 33%; the key-software refund and then HNTE status lapse, taking cash tax toward 20%; capex stays elevated on state-priority projects; slow-paying SOE customers deepen the receivables drag. No COVID-scale shock is modelled, but the lower cap multiple and 1.5% terminal growth price a structurally ex-growth regulated utility.

base.narrative: FY2026 +4.5% (H1 +5.6%, H2 'K-shaped'), fading to 2.5% as the distribution core stays volume-bound; owner EBITDA margin 38.0-38.5% (FY2025 37.0%, FY2024 38.8% on the same stripped basis, H1 FY2026 running ~4pp above H1 FY2025); capex 10% for two years on the RMB1.77bn committed programme then 8% ~= D&A; cash tax 12% rising to 15% as the key-software refund is assumed to lapse while HNTE status is retained.

bull.narrative: International capacity completes its recovery and CAAC volume growth of 5-6% flows through; settlement/clearing (+8-11%) and intelligent products (+15-19%) keep compounding; airport digitalization and the low-altitude/AI verticals add a second leg. Operating leverage on a largely fixed cost base takes owner EBITDA margin to 40%; both HNTE and key-software tax preferences are renewed; faster collections trim the working-capital drag.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: single-industry and single-regulator dependency (CAAC sets the terms of the core business), SOE governance that routes cash to minorities only through a ~35% payout with no buybacks, and a core volume line that grew 0.3% in H1 FY2026. Bull cut to 20% because it needs volume growth, margin expansion, tax renewal AND a governance re-rating to all land together. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
